title: Bind evidence to the obligation
when: When attaching QA to a workflow transition or composing item-scoped versus run-wide release QA.
need: A requirement belongs to an item/task or a deployment run, optionally a stage and member. Matching member attachments, including plans that reach a member only through an admitted requirement, share one plan/source/target execution and verdict; each member waits only on its attached groups. A shared failure blocks every attaching member, while other plans and targets remain separate.
surface: Case attachment validation; Shipping Item QA/Run QA; QA subject reads
gap: Review question: should the first mixed release show a small explanation of item-versus-run QA, with detailed binding rules fetched by the agent?
